verdict.rationale: n8n explicitly documents self-hosting on your own infrastructure via Docker Compose or other methods, offers a free Community edition and a standard self-hosted GitHub distribution, and multiple independent community reports confirm years of successful self-hosting in production. Missing for 10: clearer detail on feature parity/limitations between self-hosted Community edition vs enterprise-licensed features, and note that the license is 'fair-code' not pure OSS (per n8n-comm-19), which is a minor nuance rather than a contradiction of self-hosting capability.
